title: Uniform C¹ approximation of continuous compactly supported functions with support control
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous with tsupport f ⊆ B̄_R(0), and θ > 0. Then there is g : ℝ^P → ℝ of class C¹ with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ B̄_{R+1}(0), and |f(x) − g(x)| ≤ θ for every x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (R θ : ℝ), Continuous f → tsupport f ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R → 0 < θ → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) (R + 1) ∧ ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ θ
